fondo_rating.scoring_notes: Migrated from gravel-race-automation. Original score: 70. adventure dimension dropped, road_surface added. Score recalculated 2026-07-24 (delegated re-review, straggler pass), resolving the wave-5 flag on whether dimensions should be nulled pending a real edition. DECISION: keep numeric dimensions rather than null them, but distinguish two categories — course-fact dimensions (re-derivable from the organizer's officially announced, still-cancelled 2026 course plan, which is real published data even though unrun) vs. editorial/experiential dimensions (organization, scenic_experience, community_culture, field_depth, value, expenses, prestige, climate_risk — genuinely unvalidated with zero editions run under this brand; left unchanged and flagged as CARRIED-OVER ESTIMATES from the Coimbra-lineage migration baseline, not scored against an actual Leiria event; do not read them as independently re-verified this pass). Course-fact changes, old->new, with evidence: distance 4->3 (146.0km falls in rubric band 3 'Standard: 120-160km', not band 4 'Long: 160-200km' — this was a banding error independent of the identity question, present even under the pre-wave-5 148.1km figure). climbing 4->2 (corrected elevation is 1,478m total gain over 146km, which falls in rubric band 2 'Gentle: 500-1,500m', not band 4 'Hilly: 2,500-4,000m' — a large banding error). altitude 3->2 (Serra de Sicó's own summit is 559m above sea level per pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Serra_de_Sicó, quote 'erguendo-se a 559 metros de altitude', curl-verified 200 and text-extracted directly 2026-07-24 — this falls in rubric band 2 'Peaks at 500-1,000m', not band 3 'Summit passes at 1,000-2,000m'). descent_technicality 3->1 (SOL-REVIEW CORRECTION, applied after verification: no course-geometry evidence exists for this never-run course — the scoring_notes itself admitted 'no course-geometry evidence found,' yet the prior value asserted rubric band 3's specific claim of 'moderate switchbacks, some narrow sections.' Absent any evidence, defaulting to band 1 rather than asserting an unevidenced middle band is the honest call; corpus precedent shows terrain.technical_rating and this dimension are NOT required to track each other 1:1 across profiles, so this is not a mechanical copy of terrain.technical_rating=1, but an independent 'no evidence exists' default). climate_risk (4, unchanged) and road_surface (1, unchanged): SOL-REVIEW CORRECTION — a prior draft of this note cited Storm Kristin's cancellation-forcing damage as evidence for climate_risk=4; on review that conflates event-cancellation risk with mid-race climate exposure (the rubric's actual subject) and was retracted. climate_risk=4 is left as an unvalidated carried-over estimate, not as evidenced. Net: overall_score 67->59; TIER CHANGES 2->3 (band 45-59) — this is a real, evidence-driven tier drop, not a migration artifact, driven primarily by the climbing/distance/descent corrections.

course_description.character: The first edition under the Leiria name is set for February 27-28, 2027. Granfondo Leiria Region – Sicó Lands is the UCI Gran Fondo World Series' new name and host territory for the event run as Granfondo Coimbra Region from October 2021 to March 2025. The organizer's format: a flat 20.5 km/98 m individual time trial at Praia do Pedrógão on Saturday, February 27, then on Sunday a 146 km/1,478 m granfondo and a 93 km/1,000 m mediofondo starting and finishing in Pombal, heading into the Serra de Sicó limestone hills. The same course was planned for March 2026 and cancelled after Storm Kristin, so no race has been run on it yet.
course_description.signature_challenge: The granfondo heads into the Serra de Sicó hills for its 1,478 m of climbing; no published source details the climb geography or where the gain falls along the route.

logistics.lodging_strategy: Pombal and Leiria both have lodging. The time trial (Praia do Pedrógão) and the granfondo (Pombal) start in different places, so pick a base that works for both days.
logistics.transport: Two-day UCI qualifier: individual time trial at Praia do Pedrógão on Saturday, February 27, granfondo and mediofondo from Pombal on Sunday, February 28.

history.origin_story: The UCI called the October 2021 race the 'very first UCI Granfondo Coimbra Region'; it ran in Coimbra through March 2025 as a Portuguese qualifier on the UCI Gran Fondo World Series calendar. In January 2026 the UCI announced the move to the Leiria region under a new name, 'the new name for the successful Granfondo Coimbra Region', with the same organizer, Cabreira Solutions. The planned March 28-29, 2026 debut was cancelled after Storm Kristin damaged the region, and the organizer has set the first Leiria edition for February 27-28, 2027.

biased_opinion.verdict: Real UCI Lineage, Leiria Debut Still to Come
biased_opinion.summary: Granfondo Leiria Region – Sicó Lands is the UCI Gran Fondo World Series qualifier that ran as Granfondo Coimbra Region from 2021 to 2025. The UCI moved and renamed it for 2026, with the same organizer, Cabreira Solutions, carrying it forward. Before it could debut, Storm Kristin caused widespread damage across the Leiria region and the organizing committee cancelled the planned March 28-29, 2026 event, postponing it to 2027. The organizer now lists February 27-28, 2027, with registration open. The lineage is real; the Leiria course has never been raced.
strengths: Real UCI Gran Fondo World Series qualifier status, inherited directly from the Granfondo Coimbra Region lineage (October 2021 to March 2025)
Same organizer (Cabreira Solutions) carrying continuity forward rather than starting from nothing
Multi-event format planned: a flat time trial plus granfondo/mediofondo road races into the Serra de Sicó limestone hills
weaknesses: No edition has been held under the Leiria name yet. The course and format are the organizer's published plan, not race-day fact, and field_size is null because no field has assembled
The planned 2026 debut was cancelled outright due to Storm Kristin damage, not merely rescheduled within the year
Course figures (146 km/1,478 m) come from the organizer's plan and haven't been tested by a race
biased_opinion.bottom_line: A legitimate UCI-series successor to a real predecessor race, but don't book travel around it yet — nothing has actually run under this name, and the next date isn't confirmed.

final_verdict.one_liner: UCI qualifier with a Coimbra lineage back to 2021; the first Leiria edition is set for February 27-28, 2027 after storm damage cancelled 2026.
final_verdict.should_you_race: If you want an early-season UCI Gran Fondo World Series qualifier, yes: registration for February 27-28, 2027 is open on the organizer's site. Go in knowing the Leiria course has never been raced, so the published 146 km/1,478 m plan is all there is to judge it on.
final_verdict.alternatives: For another Portuguese road gran fondo, see the Love Tiles Douro Granfondo (Peso da Régua, Douro Valley).
